description: Source code for Odoo modules related to manufacturing subproducts, BOM, and production workflows, including class definitions and methods for handling subproducts and production confirmation.

classes.name: mrp_subproduct
classes.description: Model representing sub-products linked to manufacturing orders, with fields for product, quantity, UOM, type, and BOM.

classes.name: mrp_bom
classes.description: Model extending BOM with sub-products relationship.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Model extending production with custom confirmation logic that creates stock moves for sub-products.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates the product UOM when the product is changed.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Overrides the confirmation process to create stock moves for sub-products based on BOM and production details.
